brief: The plaza is the town's civic centre and it holds one or two people. #158 found the reason and it is not appetite: three callers — the lane's plaza band, spawnFamilyAgent, and the east agents — share FIVE places, three FOUNT_STANDS and two PLAZA_BENCHES. Measured by probes/plaza-door.mjs over 7 seeds x 60 days across a laneCap sweep of 10 to 20: CHOICES 28.7 -> 48.6, ADMISSIONS only 12.4 -> 17.3, refused 56.7% -> 64.4%, and the whole surplus leaves by the `else` onto the quay rail. Open the door. That means more places AND more than one thing to do once you are there, and it means spreading them: c236 found all three stands on the roundel's SOUTH arc, every approach coming from the south, and the 90-degree stand at (105.5, 33.5) sitting ON the lane corridor at ex2 104-106, so the arrivals you admit will collide with the arrivals you already have unless the approaches become a corridor rather than a point. This is the bet. A 150-300 line diff is expected and welcome — take the swing.
successLooksLike: On a fine afternoon the wide shot shows the plaza holding people in more than one pose, spread around the roundel instead of ranked along its south arc. probes/plaza-door.mjs at laneCap 10, same seeds: refused share below 30% and plaza presence up by at least a person, with the quay's presence NOT paying for it.
avoid: Do not raise laneCap and do not re-weight EAST_BANDS — #158 swept the ceiling 10/13/16/20 and the share, found no knee anywhere, and HELD both; the door is the bound and the sweep cannot see it. Do not answer this with two more benches of the same kind: that is a scalar, not a bet. Price presence, not a per-instant crop, and count admissions apart from choices.
